discovery_notes: Pass 3 corroboration, 38 searches. Disagreements recorded: Vault Set 3 WDWNT says Chip and Dale are separate pins (existing key combines them); WDWNT Dec 2025 first look filed the Carthay/Aurora set under a 'Castle Collection' rather than Vault. Fantasy Parades 2024 month order: Mouseketeer gives Hatbox Ghost Jan, Mr Toad Feb, Cheshire Cat Mar and WDWNT/PinVentory Tiki Apr, conflicting with existing Tiki 2024-02, Mr Toad 2024-04, Alice 2024-05. Parade edition size 2500 vs 3000 (PinVentory). Feed the Birds date 2026-04-28 vs existing 2026-05-04. Vault Set 3 date WDWNT 2026-02-10 vs existing 2026-04-07 (online). One new pin under rule 5: WMM Disney Store Flowers and Trees (set count 4); membership in completer set inferred from Disney Store WMM LE listing, review. D23 Legacy: MickeyBlog lineup omits 35th. No suspicious/instructional web content seen.
